local_deduplication.result: Before curation, two secondary-resource roots existed: fluorescent-lamp-phosphor and gaas-production-hydroxide-sludge. Battery/red-mud experiments already occurred under cobalt/aluminium element records; these are shared experiments, not new independent replications. New resource roots are distinct identities. No prior phosphogypsum record found in the searched record roots including ignored/hidden files. Coal-fly-ash and catalyst leads overlap earlier research proposals.
local_deduplication.exclusions: Unrelated home/temp trees excluded; binary absence not inferred from text search. No machine-wide or literature-wide absence claim.
